reviews.text:
I have no words.

The team here is loving, patient, kind and treats your dogs like one of their own.

We moved here last fall and were so grateful to find this space. The trainers and staff welcomed our silly, loving yet large and unpredictable dog with the utmost love, patience and care. We were surprised when they took him for group walks (a skill we had been working on). He had so much fun here and they knew how to cater to his nuance.

When he unexpectedly was diagnosed with bone cancer the owner Kelly talked to us and helped look for options and stories and care programs. They took care of him and let him rest.

When ultimately he passed way they showered us with love and affection. They left a sweet note on our porch with an orchid. They made a donation on his behalf.

This is an incredible program full of love and care. We were lucky to experience it
How did I miss this?! Thank you so much for the lovely words. We are enjoying seeing Gyro grow into the lovely young pup he is now and glad to be a part of it all!

My experience boarding my dog at Hustle Pups has been so positive.  I look forward to getting daily multiple pics of my dog having the time of her life there. I have absolutely no guilt dropping off my dog to board there.  I have guilt picking her up after seeing how happy she is there. They are the best!

HustlePups is amazing for boarding and training!  Staff is friendly and I feel safe leaving my pup there for longer term boardings knowing they keep a great schedule and watch over my pup. Love that they provide daily photo updates!
Thank you Hein! Mimi is growing so fast and holding court on her own for such a teeny thing!! It’s fun to watch!

I have been doing the owners Kelly’s hair for about about 7-8 years . I recently took over the care of a beautiful German Shepherd named Honey. Unfortunately she was abused by her previous owner and I struggled with Honeys reactive behavior which made it impossible to take honey around other people or dogs. My wish was to have Honey as a daily partner in crime and have a life together where she can join me on walks in the park or a quick drive to pick up something without have to manage and the threat factor of having a reactive dog.

Thank god for Kelly! With her training and advice. Honey became transformed!! I am now able to take her with me on daily activities and park walks with little to no issues, with only gentle commands to refocus Honey. It’s incredible the way Kelly has impacted Honey’s and I life.

Thank you Hustle Pups NYC from the bottom of our hearts!

Laddie is always excited when we arrive at Hustle Pups and very eager to go in and start playing with the other dogs boarding there!    We've only had good experiences over the numerous times we've boarded Laddie at Hustle Pups!

My dog loves going to daycare at Hustlepups, and I feel secure knowing she's in a safe, structured environment while I'm at work! I love that I can rely on their boarding services too when I'm out of town. I have also done multiple training sessions with Kelly, and she's the best- a good listener, patient, funny, and passionate!

We've been taking our dog Harley to Hustle Pups for a few years sporadically for daycare and boarding and could not be happier with how they work with our anxiety and introverted dog.  After every session he's more confident and patient around other dogs, they safely play dogs in a way I haven't experienced with other daycares.  We originally found them as a boarding option that specifically doesn't have all the dogs sleep in one room and a daycare that ensures breaks all within crates, it was surprisingly hard to find!  Their dedication to training and dog psychology is very apparent, even to us who used training elsewhere when we first got our dog (rip school for the dogs). I consistently recommend them to people in the area.

Our nervous Nellie dog spent the first few sessions being afraid of walking down the street but by the third he confidently sped walked to the door from nearly two blocks away (which he does everytime now)!

Highly recommended!

Hired Hustle Pups to help teach me and my dog tactical skills to transition him from potty pads to outdoors. We spent the entire hr (which cost $250) sitting in her car and letting my puppy play in the dog park dragging his leash around. Not only did we not make progress, but nothing in our allotted time was different or helpful than what I found online. Kelly did let me know she was recovering from a knee injury, but still charging clients the full price for 25% effort in training is not worth the money at all.
